rules.why: A product name changes rarely; 180 days, and the daily monitor flags renames earlier.
A camp does not turn into a tour or a hotel within a season; 180 days.
Business name and official site are stable; 180 days, ownership changes are caught by the monitor.
A camp's spot and country are fixed for the season; 180 days.
Our summary carries services, accommodation and season facts that change between seasons; 90 days.
Operators reprice per season and run promotions; 30 days keeps a shown price inside one pricing cycle.
Dates fill up and get added weekly; the monitor re-reads them daily, 7 days leaves room for a few failed runs.
